  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260512T125505-8f6f0cb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260512T125505-8f6f0cb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260512T125505-8f6f0cb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260512T125505-8f6f0cb6/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260512T125505-8f6f0cb6/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-7c8b1856">
    <title>Snapshot assembler: enumerate providers + harnesses, discover via cache, enrich from catalog</title>
    <description>
Build the in-memory `ModelSnapshot` view by enumerating all configured
providers (incl harnesses-as-providers), reading per-source caches
(via M1), parsing model IDs via the version-aware ranker (bead A), and
joining with catalog metadata (power, cost, reasoning_levels,
quota_pool from bead E1).

## Public API sketch

```go
package modelregistry

type Source string
const (
    SourceNativeAPI    Source = "native_api"
    SourceHarnessPTY   Source = "harness_pty"
    SourcePropsAPI     Source = "props_api"
)

type ModelStatus string
const (
    StatusAvailable     ModelStatus = "available"
    StatusRateLimited   ModelStatus = "rate_limited"
    StatusUnreachable   ModelStatus = "unreachable"
    StatusUnknown       ModelStatus = "unknown"
)

type KnownModel struct {
    // Identity (per ADR-012; matches ModelRef)
    Provider      string
    ID            string

    // How fizeau learned of it
    DiscoveredVia Source
    DiscoveredAt  time.Time

    // Parsed via bead A
    Family        string
    Version       []int
    Tier          modelcatalog.Tier
    PreRelease    bool

    // From catalog join
    Power            int
    CostInputPerM    float64
    CostOutputPerM   float64
    ContextWindow    int
    ReasoningLevels  []string
    QuotaPool        string  // E1

    // Composed eligibility (consumed by routing)
    AutoRoutable    bool      // catalog × IncludeByDefault × Status
    ExclusionReason string
}

type ModelSnapshot struct {
    Models  []KnownModel
    AsOf    time.Time
    Sources map[string]SourceMeta
}

type SourceMeta struct {
    LastRefreshedAt time.Time
    Stale           bool
    Error           string
}

func Assemble(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.Config, cat *modelcatalog.Catalog, cache *discoverycache.Cache) (ModelSnapshot, error)
```

## Provider enumeration

Iterates `cfg.Providers` (existing user config) plus implicit
subscription harnesses (claude-subscription, codex-subscription) when
their CLIs are installed and authenticated.

## Per-source discovery

Each provider type has a discovery adapter:
- openai-compat (openrouter, openai, vidar-ds4, sindri-llamacpp): GET
  `/v1/models` via cache
- ds4: also GET `/props`
- claude / codex harnesses: PTY-based cassette read via cache (existing
  model_discovery.go code, now wrapped through M1's cache)

Adapters return `[]string` (model IDs); assembler produces
`KnownModel` per ID.

## Tier ranker integration

Each model ID parsed via `modelcatalog.tiers.Parse(id)` (bead A). Sets
Family/Version/Tier/PreRelease.

## Catalog join

For each (provider, model) candidate, look up the catalog entry. If
present, populate Power/Cost/ContextWindow/ReasoningLevels/QuotaPool.
If not, leave zero/empty (snapshot still includes the entry —
provider-discovered models without catalog metadata are still
routable, just with limited info).

## AutoRoutable composition

`AutoRoutable = catalog.AutoRoutable() AND providerConfig.IncludeByDefault
AND status != StatusUnreachable AND status != StatusUnknown`. (Per
bead D's `IncludeByDefault` filter wiring.)

## Catalog-only suppression

Per operator direction: if a catalog model is NOT discovered by any
configured provider, it does NOT appear in the snapshot. The catalog
is implementation detail.

## In-scope files

- internal/modelregistry/types.go — KnownModel, ModelSnapshot, etc.
- internal/modelregistry/assemble.go — top-level Assemble function
- internal/modelregistry/discovery.go — per-provider-type adapters
  (uses existing code in internal/provider/openai/discovery.go and
  internal/harnesses/{claude,codex}/model_discovery.go through M1's
  cache wrapper)
- internal/modelregistry/enrich.go — catalog join + AutoRoutable
- internal/modelregistry/assemble_test.go
- internal/modelregistry/discovery_test.go
- internal/modelregistry/enrich_test.go

## Depends on

- M0 (ADR-012) accepted
- M1 (cache + ParseModelRef) implemented
- Bead A (`fizeau-b2c5c826`, version-aware ranker)
- Bead E1 (`fizeau-c04be6b0`, quota_pool field)

## Out of scope

- Runtime signal collection (M3 — Status comes from M3's runtime cache).
- CLI (M4).
- OR sub-provider expansion (M5).
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. `go test ./internal/modelregistry/...` passes.
2. `TestAssembleFixtureIncludesDiscoveredProviderModels` in `internal/modelregistry/assemble_test.go` covers a fixture config with openrouter, sindri-llamacpp, and vidar-ds4 and verifies `Assemble` returns one `KnownModel` per discovered `(provider, model_id)` pair.
3. `TestEnrichSnapshotPopulatesCatalogMetadataAndLeavesUnknownZero` in `internal/modelregistry/enrich_test.go` verifies catalog-enriched models receive Power/Cost/ContextWindow/ReasoningLevels/QuotaPool and uncataloged discovered models keep zero/empty metadata.
4. `TestAssembleSuppressesCatalogOnlyModels` verifies catalog-only entries that no configured provider discovers do not appear in the snapshot.
5. `TestAutoRoutableComposition` verifies AutoRoutable is true only when catalog eligibility, provider IncludeByDefault, and reachable status all allow routing, and records an exclusion reason otherwise.
6. `go vet ./...` passes.
    </acceptance>
    <notes>
Operator refined ACs into named test/build/vet checks and cleared stale AC-quality gate metadata.
